perspective: Security engineer finding these artifacts on an endpoint

decisions.rationale: The complete Node.js 20.20.1 Windows executable matches the official release except for one byte at 0x19c: OptionalHeader.Subsystem changes from console (3) to GUI (2). Reverting that byte reproduces the official SHA-256 exactly. The retained signature has a true image-digest mismatch, detected as suspicious; the GUI-runtime mismatch composite also fires. There is no injected code or embedded SEA payload. The altered runtime can avoid console allocation, but the surrounding launcher or scripts needed to establish its deployment purpose are unavailable.

high_findings.description: GUI Node runtime has an invalid image digest

decisions.rationale: Dedicated Mythic post-exploitation operator UI imports JSON callback configurations and invokes the importCallbackConfig GraphQL mutation to transfer control of callbacks between Mythic servers. Its implemented C2 operation establishes the classification; operator authorization does not change it.

Dedicated Mythic post-exploitation operator UI reads payload-definition JSON and submits it through createPayload(payloadDefinition: ...) to the payload build pipeline. This is an operative payload-building interface, rather than an inert generic React helper.

The npm preinstall hook runs load.js. After probing fixed addresses on TCP 18393, the loader Base64-encodes host/user identity, POSTs it by curl to the reachable address on HTTP 8443 at /setting/profile, and pipes the response into /bin/sh. It then executes tnpm install for the scoped identity package. This install-time remote shell loader and package replacement are sufficiently established without obtaining or executing the remote stage.

high_findings.description: Preinstall profiles host and runs shell stage

decisions.rationale: A tiny package executes dns.resolve against a fixed operator domain when imported and logs a callback-sent claim, providing an out-of-band execution probe. Hostname, working-directory and network-interface collection feed callbackData, but that string is unused: host-data exfiltration was not demonstrated. The fake-package research description does not neutralize its live execution callback.

high_findings.description: Load-time DNS callback with host inventory

decisions.rationale: The published package entry issues a top-level HTTP GET to an OAST collector as soon as it is imported, then exposes a dummy export. This is a live out-of-band execution probe. No credential or host-inventory payload is explicitly transmitted.

high_findings.description: Tiny published entry beacons to OOB collector
Module body directly requests an OOB collector

node_comparison.interpretation: The complete executable matches the official runtime except for the console-to-GUI subsystem byte. The changed field suppresses console allocation and invalidates the existing signature. No injected runtime code or embedded application payload was identified. The surrounding launcher or scripts are still needed to establish purpose.
